content: Ninyambucha
Ne Yakobu, natumiche jwa Chapanga na jwa Bhambo Yecho Kilichitu. Ninyambucha mangota, bhumii makabila kome na mabhele ghighajhenii mu nnema ghoha.
Kihobholelo na Malango
Makalongo bhango, pimukongana na majhighanikilo gha kila namuna nhwanganila hake,
mmanye kubhehe kujhighanikilwa kwa kihobholelo chino kumpe uhotolo gwa kuhimbilila.
Mmanye kubhehe kuhimbilila kwino nakunkangamalicha ade kupehekela, kupala nkomale na ntimile pangapokewa na kilebhe chochoha.
Nambo anda mundo jhumo pakate jhino apongokilwe malango ghukumanya, bhahe, ipalwa annyopa Chapanga nampela kwa umbone nhwalo Chapanga ndi jwabhapela bhoha kwa umahele na kwa umbone.
Nambo ipalwa ajhopa kwa kihobholelo changapwelela. Nhwalo mundo jwabhii na mbwelelo abhehe ngita lituhe lya umbwane lilipogwite nu upepo na kutagwa kongo na oko.
Nhwalo mundo jwawachii ilebhe na jwangakitamo na matyangilo ghake, angawachii jhe napata kilebhe kubhoke kwa Bhambo.
Mundo jwabhii na ndela ibhele upapalakana mundela yenio yoha.
Nhocho na kubhehe na ilebhe mbwe
Anda nnongo jwabhii nhocho ipalwa ahangana nhwalo Chapanga anyinwile,
na jwabhii na ilebhe mbwe ahangana pahuluchwa. Nhwalo jhuna ilebhe nahobhelela ngita lilobha lya kwanyahe.
Nhwalo lyobha pilipita na kubhehe ngilii ujhomecha imelite, na malobha ghake uponekee pahe na kuhalala kwake koha unhobhelela. Ndi chiibhile kwa jwabhii na ilebhe mbwe nakomelekewa mu mahengo ghake.
Kupemwa na kujhighanikilwa
Mbaha mundo jhola jwahimbilila pajhighanikilwa, nhwalo anda ahimbilile ade kupehekela, napelwa ndweko jha ughome gwalaghii Chapanga kwapela bhibhampala.
Anda mundo ajhighanikilwe, angalonge jhe, “Anyigha Chapanga.” Nhwalo Chapanga ahoto jhe kujhighanikilwa na uhakaho, annyigha jhe mundo jhojhoha.
Nambo kila mundo ujhighanikilwe pautilwa na kujhonjeka mitama yake yanganandela.
Kabhele tama jhene mboho anda ikomile ileta uhakaho na uhakaho anda ukomii uleta kuwegha.
Makalongo bhango bhinimpala, bhangankolowa jhe!

Kila kitohe chambone na kila hupo yoha itimile ibhoka kunane kwa Chapanga, ibhoka kwa Tate jwapangine mule imulika kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga, jwangabadilika hilu kughalambuka ghalambuka ngita nhwile.
Kwa kupala kwake ngatupapita kwa uhyono kwa ndela jha lilobhe lyake lya chakaka, kupala tubhehe bhakutumbuu pakate ya ihumbe yoha yapangine.
Kujhoha na kuhenga
Makalongo bhango bhunimpala, nkomboka kilebhe chenje: Kila mundo abhaha na kipyao cha kujhoha nambo angabhehe jhe na kipyao cha kulonge amu angabhehe jhe na kipyao cha kuyoma.
Nhwalo lilaka lya mundo lihoto jhe kuhenga ghamaha ghapala Chapanga.
Yene, maghataghii kutale uhakaho ghoha na ghanganandela ghighabhii ghamahele hake, mupokele kwa kunyenyekeya lilobhe lyamichite umiojho jhino, lihoto kughombola uhuke gwino.
Mangakikoloya jhe mabhene kwa kulijhokanikii tugha lilobhe lyake nambo mipalwa kulikamuu na kulihenge lihengo.
Nhwalo anda mundo jhojhoha jwajhokanikii lilobhe nambo alihenge jhe lihengo, jwenio anda mundo jwakilolekeya chula jhake mu lindala.
Anda ajhomwii kukilolekeya jwenio ubhoka, na ajhewite chula jhake chiibhile.

Nambo mundo jwalolekeya kwa miho mabhele mihilo jhitimile jhijhabheka bhando changatabha, na ajhendelee kuhenga gheniya na chi kwa kujhokanikiya tugha na palonge alibhilila, nambo kwa kughahenge lihengo, mundo jwenio napata mota mu kila kilebhe chahenga.
Mundo anda akibhona ndi jwa dine kone aluhibhiijhe lulime lwake dine jhake akikolowa jwenio, itangatii jhe kilebhe chochoha.
Dine jhibhii jhamaha jhanga malemwa palonge jha Chapanga Tate ndi jhenje: Kwatangatii akakebha na akanawela mu malola ghabhe, kukilonda mabhene muluku lwa nnema ghongo.
